title: The Rulio Qi Method — 12 Free Sessions
description: Binaural-beat and solfeggio frequency sessions for sleep, focus, energy, and creative flow.
disclaimer: Not a medical device. Not a treatment for any condition. Headphones required.

sessions.title: Sleep
sessions.instruction: Lie down. Close your eyes. Don't try to fall asleep — let the tones pull you there.

sessions.title: Deep Sleep
sessions.instruction: For the middle of the night, when you wake at 3am and need to drop back under. Headphones on, eyes closed.

sessions.title: Morning Reset
sessions.instruction: First 5 minutes of your day. Before phone. Before mirror. Sit, headphones, breathe.

sessions.title: Anxiety Release
sessions.instruction: When the chest tightens and the to-do list starts to scroll in your head. Anywhere. Headphones in, eyes soft.

sessions.title: Focus
sessions.instruction: Deep work block. Use between Pomodoros to keep the rhythm going when the timer ends.

sessions.title: Focus (25 min)
sessions.instruction: The long version. For full deep-work blocks. Pomodoro is 25 min — match the rhythm.

sessions.title: Deep Work
sessions.instruction: For the hardest problem of the day. Headphones mandatory. Close every other tab.

sessions.title: Deep Work (25 min)
sessions.instruction: The long version. 25 minutes of low-beta 14 Hz with the 417+852 stack. Headphones mandatory. Close every other tab. Don't touch the keyboard until the timer ends.

sessions.title: Second Wind
sessions.instruction: 3pm dip. Don't reach for the third coffee. Headphones, sit upright, breathe twice as long out as in.

sessions.title: Creative Spark
sessions.instruction: Use before a brainstorm or when the blank page is staring back. Pen in hand. Don't judge what comes out.

sessions.title: Connection
sessions.instruction: Before a hard conversation. Don't script — just listen first. The 639 puts you in the headspace where listening happens.

sessions.title: Intuition
sessions.instruction: When you have a decision to make and the spreadsheets aren't telling you anything. Sit, breathe, ask the question out loud. Listen for the next 5 minutes.

sessions.title: Evening Review
sessions.instruction: End of day. Open the journal. Three sentences: what shipped, what didn't, what's the one thing tomorrow.

sessions.title: Pre-Pitch
sessions.instruction: Five minutes before the call that matters. Headphones in. Slow exhale. The 963 won't calm you down — it will sharpen you up.
